summary.headline: The King’s Condition
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging planetary strength, impediment, combustion, angularity, and house placements, including significations of infirmity, death, sadness, captivity, and enmity. Chapter 42 begins discussion of the king’s condition during the year, especially journeys, war, and the lord of the house of journeys in a revolution chart.
